scope: Brand-related exact DS categorical treemap colors, near-Thailand camera envelope, settled-host basemap resizing, one-row four controls grouped in two pairs, and comma-separated visible numbers. Read-only display/navigation refinement.

treemapBrandColors.policy: Use exact approved categorical DS hue families near each verified original logo primary color; stable identity mapping. Explicit stable hash fallback for absent/unresolved identity; neutral09 for monochrome and exact Other. Original artwork and quantitative color/size meanings stay unchanged.
treemapBrandColors.themePolicy: Use exact original LDS separate light/dark categorical soft-fill/ink CSS token values (--ldm-series-NN-fill-light/dark); identity family stable across themes. These approved categorical theme tables are separate from unchanged quantitative/Story/Location data HEX.
treemapBrandColors.mappingMethod: Source-backed manual review of original logo primary hue → closest suitable existing DS categorical family; basis and original asset SHA recorded per identity. No numerical nearest-color guarantee or official corporate-color claim.

grocery-brand:GOURMET_MARKET.basis: Burgundy-red circular badge; gold lettering is secondary.

grocery-brand:DONKI.basis: Blue native Donpen badge field; yellow bill is secondary.

grocery-brand:RIMPING.basis: Monochrome original: neutral approved category, no inferred brand hue.

grocery-brand:FUJI.basis: Red native Fuji Super badge field.

bangchak.basis: Green leaf identity; orange upper segment is secondary.

ptt.basis: Cyan outer flame is primary; deep-blue and red inner flame remain original.

shell.basis: Yellow pecten shell interior; red outline is secondary.

caltex.basis: Red star badge is primary; deep teal is secondary.

treemapBrandColors.fallbackPolicy: COSMO/PURE identity unresolved: retain FNV-1a stable brand-ID categorical slot. Unknown/nonselectable source legal IDs use the same stable hash fallback; no identity inferred from brand text.
treemapBrandColors.monochromePolicy: Rimping/Krungsri Auto monochrome originals use neutral category09 without inferred family/owner hue.
treemapBrandColors.otherPolicy: Exact Other identified competitor sum uses neutral category09 with inspectable named membership.

tokens.ink: Exact existing per-theme categorical ink roles
tokens.smallDarkCategory10Labels: Exact neutral light-canvas backdrop behind small labels/cue, preserving original category10 fill and original artwork

treemapBrandColors.cuePolicy: Original ten category shape cues retained; same hue may identify multiple brands, therefore labels/original artwork/counts remain necessary.
treemapBrandColors.evidenceLimit: Original graphic byte binding and observed hue rationale, not an official brand-guideline endorsement or all-brand rendered accessibility certificate.

mapCameraEnvelope.meaning: Constrain viewing near Thailand with a padded display envelope; navigation aid, not statutory national boundary or data scope. Preserve saved/context camera where inside envelope; clamp only out-of-envelope camera.
mapCameraEnvelope.implementation: countryContextZoomFloor calculates whole-context fit from actual current host/projected corners without feedback from current minZoom. applyMapZoomFloor clamps zoom only if below floor, then sets the host-dependent map minZoom. Apply on initial map/actual host resize.
mapCameraEnvelope.cameraRule: Preserve same map and camera when zoom/center are within current host-dependent near-Thailand envelope. Only an out-of-envelope camera may be clamped after resize; no unconditional country fit or analytical/data-scope mutation.
mapCameraEnvelope.minimumZoomPolicy: Host-dependent whole-Thailand context zoom floor, computed independently of the current minZoom.

minimumZoomFormula.projection: Project context north-west/south-east corners at zoom0 via map.project
minimumZoomFormula.allowanceScope: Before absolute3..19 provider/base caps; round-down adds less than0.25 to0.25 initial margin.
minimumZoomFormula.fallback: 3 for width or height <=36, unavailable projection/getScaleZoom, or nonfinite/nonpositive scale/zoom. Larger valid hosts use the dynamic floor.

expandedBasemapResize.policy: Invalidate Leaflet after the map host has settled at its current size; retain the same map/camera/scope/criteria/forms. Existing integer-tile-zoom layer recreation remains the explicit provider retry path. Never infer provider availability from CSS or mocks.
sequence: Observe actual host width/height via ResizeObserver and existing explicit Expand/Compact path
Immediately invalidate map with pan:true,animate:false; preserve view for explicit expansion
Coalesce imagery resize in requestAnimationFrame until host dimensions are stable for one frame
Recheck same map/current tile layer and nonzero settled size; ignore canceled/outdated work
Invalidate final size with preserveView:true,refreshBasemap:false, then recreate only current same-style TileLayer via setBasemap(S.basemap) at integer provider tile zoom
expandedBasemapResize.cancellation: Style change cancels queued old-layer work; zero-size/no-imagery hosts cannot initiate stale work.
expandedBasemapResize.retainedCamera: Permitted fractional camera zoom/center remain; clamp only out-of-envelope zoom/center. Leaflet TileLayer owns integer tile coordinates. No map remount or unconditional country fit for explicit expansion.
expandedBasemapResize.diagnosis: User-reported gaps were not reproduced during the root native baseline; current settled-host reconstruction hardens imagery resize without asserting a proven root cause.
expandedBasemapResize.providerRule: Source adapter tests do not prove provider availability. Sampled actual native tile completion after repeated cycles is required.
expandedBasemapResize.cameraConstraintException: Host-dependent geographic floor/bounds may clamp only an out-of-envelope zoom/center after resize; preserve permitted fractional camera exactly.

compactMapControls.layout: One compact .workspace-map-tools row with two pairs: Options/Expand and Region colours/Branch points. Supply count/share remains in supporting analysis controls.
compactMapControls.responsive: Row stays together at narrow/desktop widths; actual label/control geometry remains a native acceptance gate.

numberDisplay.policy: Format finite displayed numerical quantities with comma grouping while preserving existing precision, units, sign, interval/missing states and raw numerical calculation values. No compact K/M abbreviation that conceals a requested exact count.
boundaries: Source counts, ratios, percentages, labels, lists, legends, tooltips and read-only numerical summaries
Editable raw numeric inputs, IDs, version/date codes, coordinates and formula/source syntax retain their parsing/identity meaning; do not introduce grouped input strings
numberDisplay.formatter: formatDisplayNumber(value) in prototype/model.js using Intl.NumberFormat(th-TH/en-US,{maximumFractionDigits:20}); retained per-surface precision formatters use grouping too.
numberDisplay.rawInputPolicy: criteria-controls readout/ARIA/grouped labels change only; raw range min/max/value and number input values remain unchanged including rate precision.
surfaces: model supply bounds and calibration/history display

acceptance: Each verified brand has a stable exact approved DS categorical swatch chosen near its original artwork primary color; names/counts remain readable in both themes; no artwork mutation.
Near-Thailand envelope blocks unrelated distant panning/zooming without changing administrative scope or Demand membership.

Expand/Compact waits for a settled host then recreates only same-style imagery at integer tile zoom, preserving map instance, permitted fractional camera and unsaved work; clamp only out-of-envelope zoom/center. Actual sampled native tiles load after repeated cycles.

Options/Expand and Region colours/Branch points remain four labeled meaningful-icon buttons in one compact row/two pairs at recorded narrow/desktop widths. Count/share controls retain their supporting-analysis meanings.
All visible numerical quantities consistently use comma grouping and preserve precision/units/no-data/bounds, while calculation/storage/input values stay numerical.
Actual TH/EN narrow/desktop and both themes are reviewed; per-state observed checks are not a physical-device/full-matrix certificate.

native.scope: Bounded current review of allfive requested refinements. Actual final runtime screenshots cover TH/EN,light/dark,desktop/narrow; not a complete matrix, physical-device or every-brand/boundary certification. Baseline1.9.6 user-reported tile gap did not reproduce in one expansion; resize reconstruction verified against repeated final Expand/Collapse and host reflow.

renderedChecks.observation: Final dynamic zoom floor disables zoom-out near Thailand; two native 590px eastward drags return to the same Thailand context. All sampled basemap positions remain covered.
Final map expanded 1002→1342px and rapidly collapsed/expanded/collapsed; 160/160 sampled positions covered by loaded tiles, four 44px controls remain in one row.

Thai light Bangkok map: one Lat Krabang tooltip, source total175 and123 own=70.3%; ≤5 tiles with stable red/cyan/yellow/green DS brand colors plus neutral Other, bounded inside map. Province side panel remains direct4,982/77.4%.

390×844 Thai dark: four44px buttons stay one row without horizontal overflow; native Expand grows host457.8→560.6px with160/160 covered samples. Collapse then swipe moves map top to−1095px and reveals full details/treemap4,982/77.4%, confirming natural page flow.

390×844 ENlight private count draft: entered12345 displays12,345 records, numeric input remains12345, slider bounds1/100 unchanged and out-of-range note visible; no overlap/horizontal overflow. No team Apply performed.
No captured browser error entries in this native local session after final reload, resize cycles, brand/theme/language changes, count/share hover and criteria private-draft input/reset.
